name: Iron ore
note: Not on US list; on China's strategic list and the largest China–Brazil mineral flow by value (Vale). Included as a denominator for shares.
why_it_matters: Not on the US list, but on China's strategic list; the China–Brazil iron-ore trade is the largest mineral flow between the two powers and the region, so it is kept as a denominator for shares and as context.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
